description: He wears a substantial knee-length dark olive-green tunic with broad gold-brown knotwork borders at the front, cuffs and hem, over a cream textured underlayer visible near the lower edge. A dark green and brown checked woven cloak wraps the shoulders and drapes down the sides, secured by a large circular brooch at anatomical left shoulder. A broad decorated brown leather belt with circular fittings and a hanging end shapes the waist. Brown trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots with crossed wraps. Dark fitted wrist pieces appear below the sleeves as soft leather accents, not armor. All cloth is opaque; craftsmanship is ornate but practical, with no weapon or headgear.
